notes.title: Super Cakeboy 2.1 Now Out!
notes.notes:
I want to say thanks to everyone who tried the game and for all of the positive comments so far! I was worried people wouldn't be happy with such a small game, even though it was free. Thank you for playing my game.

2.1 introduces some Japanese language fixes as well as a few other minor fixes.

[b]Version 2.1 - April 1, 2023:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed issue in settings menu where changing VSync setting would sometimes reset display resolution.
[*]Japanese translation fixes.
[*]Updated icon and game description.[/list]
